lines: Now meet the newest product in the Apex family — Jordyn.
Jordyn is an A.I. assistant with a brain for your business — it arrives already knowing your industry.
Unlike a generic chatbot, Jordyn learns from a professional's real inbox and real clients.
It reads and manages email, answers the phone, and builds a pipeline automatically.
Every morning it delivers a briefing of what needs attention, so nothing slips.
Who's it for? Agents, realtors, attorneys — any busy professional buried in follow-up.
The promise: it gives back about eight hours a week, roughly two thousand dollars in time.
It's a hundred forty-nine a month, and like the others, recurring income for you.
Your pitch: an assistant that actually runs your day, not just chats about it.
That's Jordyn. Now let's cover the Insurance side of the business. Let's go.
